sources.text: Research Labs Many of our faculty members have labs that conduct research in a variety of specialties. Check out some of their websites featuring their research: Alzheimer's Disease Cooperative Study (ADCS) – Feldmen Autism Center of Excellence – Courchesne and Pierce Brewer Lab – UC San Diego Human Memory Laboratory Campbell Lab Cleveland Lab – Ludwig Cancer Research Daneman Lab Desplats Lab Devor Lab – Neurovascular Imaging Laboratory (NIL) Dore Lab Ellisman Lab – Center for Research in Biological Systems (CRBS) Gholipour Lab – Epilepsy Imaging Research Gleeson Neurogenetics Lab – Laboratory of Pediatric Brain Disease Graves Neuro-immunology Research Group Hnasko Lab Kim-McManus Lab – PrecisionTherapeutics Neuro-Inverventional Center Komiyama Lab – a systems neuroscience laboratory Malinow Lab – Center for Neural Circuits & Behavior (CNCB) Mobley Lab Raju Lab Rich Lab Roy Lab – Neuronal Cell Biology and Neurodegeneration Shiley-Marcos Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) - Banks, Brewer, Galasko, Gonzalez, Jacobs, Leger, Peavy, Salmon Shtrahman Lab Sternson Lab Townsend Lab – Research on Autism and Development (RADLab) Tuszynski Lab – Center for Neural Repair Ung Lab - Translational Neurophysiology Wu Lab Zheng Lab

sources.title: Don Cleveland Lab
sources.text: About the Lab Dr. Cleveland’s research efforts are focused in 2 major directions: Genome rearrangement in cancer Mechanism and therapy for human neurodegenerative disease Don W. Cleveland Department Chair, Cellular and Molecular Medicine (CMM) Professor, Cellular and Molecular Medicine UCSD Profile Google Scholar Profile FDA APPROVES TREATMENT OF ALS FDA approved Qalsody (tofersen) to treat patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) associated with a mutation in the superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) gene (SOD1-ALS).
